title: Robust Evidential Learning Through Latent Consistency
abstract: arXiv:2610.01384v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reliable uncertainty quantification is essential for deploying deep learning models in high-stakes settings, where out-of-distribution and adversarial inputs can induce confident but unreliable predictions. Evidential Deep Learning provides efficient uncertainty estimates in a single forward pass, but can still assign high evidential strength to inputs that are poorly supported by the learned representation, such as adversarial inputs. We introduce CLEAR, a lightweight, task-agnostic post-hoc method that improves evidential robustness without retraining or altering the base prediction. Using held-out calibration data, CLEAR characterises the group-conditioned geometry of the model's latent space. At inference, it efficiently generates perturbation views directly in the latent space and measures their conflict relative to the calibrated geometry of the predicted group. High latent conflict indicates unsupported evidence, which CLEAR uses

translated_title: 通过潜在一致性实现鲁棒的证据学习
translated_abstract: 可靠的不确定性量化对于在高风险环境中部署深度学习模型至关重要，因为分布外和对抗性输入可能引发自信但不可靠的预测。证据深度学习能够在单次前向传播中提供高效的不确定性估计，但仍可能对学习表示支持不足的输入（如对抗性输入）赋予较高的证据强度。我们提出CLEAR，这是一种轻量级、任务无关的事后方法，无需重新训练或改变基础预测即可提升证据的鲁棒性。利用留出的校准数据，CLEAR刻画了模型潜在空间中基于组别条件的几何结构。在推理时，它直接在潜在空间中高效生成扰动视图，并相对于预测组别的校准几何结构来衡量其冲突程度。高度潜在冲突表明证据缺乏支持，CLEAR利用这一点……（摘要内容在此处截断）
tldr: CLEAR是一种轻量级、任务无关的事后方法，通过在潜在空间中生成扰动视图并衡量其与校准几何结构的冲突程度来识别缺乏支持的证据，无需重新训练即可提升证据深度学习在面对分布外和对抗性输入时的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: CLEAR is a lightweight, task-agnostic post-hoc method that detects unsupported evidence by generating latent perturbation views and measuring their conflict against calibrated group geometry, improving the robustness of evidential deep learning without retraining.
